title: Kick on every beat
text: Count 1, 2, 3, 4 aloud with the click. Play Kick L with your left hand.

intro.goal: Keep four equally spaced beats.
intro.watch: Avoid squeezing in an extra hit at the end of the bar.

title: A steady right hand
text: Play Hat R with your right hand. Keep your wrist loose and your taps small.

intro.goal: Keep the same pulse with your right hand.
intro.watch: Do not speed up between beats 3 and 4.

title: Snare on two and four
text: Count every beat; play Snare L with your left hand only on 2 and 4.

intro.goal: Keep counting through the silent beats.
intro.watch: The empty beats still take the same amount of time.

title: Kick, snare, kick, snare
text: Keep your left hand over Kick L and Snare L. Alternate the pads on the four beats.

intro.goal: Change pads without changing the pulse.
intro.watch: Move your fingers rather than lifting the whole hand.

title: Hands take turns
text: Count 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Play kick with your left hand; each & is Hat R with your right hand.

intro.goal: Put the right hand halfway between left-hand beats.
intro.watch: Do not bunch the right-hand hit close to the kick.

title: Kick and hat together
text: Play Kick L and Hat R together with both hands on every beat. Listen for one combined attack.

intro.goal: Land two different pads at the same instant.
intro.watch: Two separate attacks mean the hands are drifting apart.

title: Snare and hat together
text: Your right hand plays Hat R on all four beats. Add Snare L with your left hand to the same click on beats 2 and 4.

intro.goal: Keep hats steady while the snare joins on 2 and 4.
intro.watch: Do not pause the right hand when the left hand joins.

title: Your first groove
text: Your right hand keeps the pulse on Hat R. Your left hand alternates kick and snare.

intro.goal: Combine kick, backbeat and quarter-note hats.
intro.watch: Keep the snare on 2 and 4 as solid as the kick.

title: Eight steady hats
text: Count 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Play every syllable with your right hand on Hat R.

intro.goal: Divide each beat into two equal parts.
intro.watch: Keep the & evenly between the numbered beats.

title: Hats with a kick anchor
text: Your right hand plays eighth notes on Hat R. Your left hand joins on Kick L only on beats 1 and 3.

intro.goal: Keep eight hats flowing over kicks on 1 and 3.
intro.watch: Do not accent or delay every hat just because a kick joins.

title: A complete backbeat
text: Keep your right hand moving on Hat R. Your left hand plays Kick L on 1 and 3 and Snare L on 2 and 4.

intro.goal: Play a complete one-bar rock/pop groove.
intro.watch: Watch the simultaneous hat/snare attacks on 2 and 4.

title: A two-bar phrase
text: Count both bars and keep the second bar identical to the first.

intro.goal: Repeat the groove across a visible two-bar phrase.
intro.watch: Do not leave a gap at the bar line or rush the return to bar 1.

title: Extra kick after two
text: The extra left-hand kick is on the & of 2, after the left-hand snare.

intro.goal: Add a kick between beats without moving the snare.
intro.watch: Keep hats flowing while the left fingers alternate.

title: Extra kick after three
text: Your left hand plays kick on 3 and the & of 3, then the next snare on 4.

intro.goal: Play two eighth-note kicks with a steady right hand.
intro.watch: Do not move beat 4 earlier to make room for the extra kick.

title: Dance offbeats
text: Play every numbered beat on Kick L with your left hand; answer on each & on Hat R with your right hand.

intro.goal: Feel offbeat hats against a four-beat kick.
intro.watch: Keep the kick pulse steady even when the hats feel stronger.

title: Dance with a clap
text: Your left hand plays kick on every beat and adds clap on 2 and 4. Your right hand plays the offbeat hats.

intro.goal: Add a clap backbeat to a dance pulse.
intro.watch: Play kick and clap together with your left hand on 2 and 4; keep the left wrist relaxed.

title: One open hat
text: Play closed hats with your right hand. On 4 &, play Open hat above it in 16-pad mode or next to it in 8-pad mode with the same hand.

intro.goal: Change just the final hat to an open hat.
intro.watch: The open hat replaces the closed hit; it is not an extra hit.

title: Strong and soft hats
text: Listen first. Emphasise numbered beats and tap the & more gently.

intro.goal: Hear alternating strong and soft hats.
intro.watch: Timing is scored; loudness is not. A keyboard cannot reproduce MIDI velocity.

title: A first sixteenth pair
text: Count the last beat 4 e & a. Your right hand plays Hat R on 4, &, a; the next 1 stays in place.

intro.goal: Fit two quick hats at the end of the bar.
intro.watch: Keep the final two taps small and relaxed; lower BPM if tense.

title: Rest without losing time
text: Count 4 & even though the & is silent. Return to 1 exactly with the click.

intro.goal: Keep the pulse through a missing final hat.
intro.watch: Do not shorten the silent space at the end of the bar.

title: A one-beat snare fill
text: Right hand stops after 3 &. Your left hand plays the snare on 4 and 4 &.

intro.goal: Switch from groove to a short snare fill on beat 4.
intro.watch: The fill must end in time for the next kick on 1.

title: A kick and snare answer
text: Keep your left hand on snare and kick. Right hand rests during the answer.

intro.goal: Answer the snare on 4 with a kick on 4 &.
intro.watch: Treat the fill as part of the pulse; do not accelerate it.

title: A short tom answer
text: Your right hand plays High tom on 4 and Low tom on 4 &. Check the highlighted tom positions before starting.

intro.goal: Move to two toms while keeping the bar length.
intro.watch: In 8-pad mode the two toms occupy unused top-row slots. The left hand rests during the fill. Reposition the right hand calmly before beat 4.

title: Groove, fill, return
text: Bar 1 is the full groove. Bar 2 ends with two snare hits. Return to kick and hat together on bar 1.

intro.goal: Join a groove bar, fill bar and clean return.
intro.watch: Keep the same BPM across both bars; the fill does not change the pulse.
